A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card with the corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 January 2013.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-D-comewithme-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Come With Me]] (Decipher; Decipher's [[Come With Me (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes: “attempt to eliminate” becomes “target”; “starfighter's” becomes “starfighter having one or more”; “pilot.” becomes “pilots.”; “all” is added after “remove”; “pilot.” becomes “pilots (otherwise, Effect is lost).”; “now” is dropped; “1 pilot. Must have” becomes “one”; “aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.” becomes “for each permanent pilot removed.”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “Come With Me” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
